items.title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
items.summary: Realistic environment replicas are increasingly valuable for training and evaluating LLM agents, yet the original systems may be inaccessible or impractical to reproduce. We explore agentic language world modeling: rather than rebuilding an executable environment, a world model agent serves as the environment for a task agent and supports faithful and stateful simulation. items.summary: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. items.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. items.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. items.title: In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks
items.summary: We study robotic in-context learning (ICL), an emerging paradigm that enables robots to infer and execute tasks from visual demonstrations. items.title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
items.summary: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. items.title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
items.summary: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. items.title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
items.summary: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. items.summary: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. items.title: Foundations of Large Language Models
items.summary: This is a book about large language models. As indicated by the title, it primarily focuses on foundational concepts rather than comprehensive coverage of all cutting-edge technologies. items.summary: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. items.title: TestPrism: Rethinking Test Evaluation Beyond a Single Reference
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents have advanced test generation across diverse programming tasks. However, the common practice of evaluating tests against a single reference solution overlooks alternative valid implementations and can overstate test quality. items.title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
items.summary: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. items.title: U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models
items.summary: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? items.summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. items.summary: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. items.title: Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing
items.summary: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. items.title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
items.summary: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. items.title: SparseEngine: Sparse-First Inference Engine
items.summary: Long-context LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that strain KV-cache memory and attention computation. items.summary: As agents take on long-horizon tasks, users shift from making individual decisions to overseeing autonomous execution. items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits.
